**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Sir](../persons.html#448)[^1]
I think it would be well to send me a set of sheets of What to Read, that I might add to them or cancel them on occasion. I know there are some good books of this winter not added, and Goldhanger Woods,[^2] and I have not seen a sheet since before Christmas. I am afraid the books may be forgotten and omitted if I do not set them down soon
Yours &c

C M Yonge

[^1]: Duncan was her usual correspondent at the [National Society](../others.html#32), the publishers of [What Books to Lend and What to Give](../books.html#196) (1887), but she usually called him Mr Duncan.

[^2]: Mary and Catherine Lee, Goldhanger Woods: A Child\'s Romance (London: National Society 1886).

Mary Lee had collaborated with CMY on [The Miz Maze](../books.html#165) (1883).
